procedural_matters: ITA 75 was represented by Lorenzo PEZZILLI.
POL 64 was represented by Mikolaj STANIUL.
POL 64 provided video evidence of the incident.
Jon Napier (Chairman of the International Jury) gave evidence as a witness.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 12-15 knots of wind and flat water.
During the last minute before the starting signal, ITA 75 and POL 64 were sailing on starboard tack, with POL 64 sailing 3 boat lengths clear ahead and 2.5 boat lengths to leeward of ITA 75.
POL 64 luffed and passed head to wind.
While POL 64 was tacking, ITA 75 bore away to a converging course with POL 64.
Immediately after, POL 64 tacked again onto starboard tack.
Before POL 64 reached a close-hauled course on starboard tack, ITA 75 luffed on a course to pass to windward of POL 64.
conclusions: When changing course, ITA 75 the right-of-way boat gave POL 64 room to keep clear and did not break RRS 16.1.
After passing head to wind, and before being on a close-hauled course, POL 64 failed to keep clear of ITA 75. POL 64 broke RRS 13.
Since POL 64 broke RRS 13 while she was sailing within the room to which she was entitled, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(b) for this breach.
